data.summary: Retail stocks were on track to post modest gains in Friday’s holiday-shortened trading session.  The SPDR S&P Retail ETF, also known by its ticker, XRT, was up 0.2%, compared with the S&P 500’s 0.3% gain.  Walmart stock was up 0.8%, Costco Wholesale gained 0.5%, and Target rose 1.5%.
